display.title: Episode 254: The Return of Yehudah, the Secret Message at the Chuppah
display.summary_short: The Shabbos Candle Contest is extended, a pre-1A class leads the Shema, Yehudah opens the old man's secret message under the chuppah, and mitzvah time explains the first words of the candle brachah.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi opens the mail full of drawings for his Shabbos Candle Contest and extends it until Chanukah. He reads a mother's warm letter about her children dancing to the Hakochainik march, and then everyone marches along. At story time, The Return of Yehudah nears its end: Yehudah, now the town melamed, is chosen by the rav as his son-in-law, while the rav's gabbai, Reb Boruch, and his daughter Miriam accept with grace that it was not meant for them. Before the story continues, a pre-1A class from a Boro Park girls' school leads the Shema, and one girl recites a Yiddish piece about lighting Shabbos candles. Under the chuppah, Yehudah removes the secret note sewn into his tallis katan long ago, reads it, and stands frozen; the climax comes next week. Mitzvah time continues the lessons on Shabbos candles: we light no later than 18 minutes before sunset, and before every mitzvah we say a brachah, speaking directly to Hashem with 'Baruch Atah Hashem Elokeinu'. The show ends with a phone quiz offer, candle-lighting time, and a reminder to begin V'sein tal u'matar.
display.lesson: Before every mitzvah we stop and make a brachah, remembering that we are speaking directly to Hashem and doing what He commanded.

date.note: Candle lighting 'this Friday, December the 5th, 1986' and V'sein tal u'matar 'this Thursday night, December the 4th'; the Tuesday before is 2 December 1986.

privacy.note: A girl from the visiting class gives her full name; the teacher and a letter-writing mother are named.
